channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan tourist spending rises despite drop in visitor arrivals
item.description: The news comes as Japan approaches the one-year mark since Chinese authorities began issuing advisories urging citizens to avoid travel to Japan.

item.title: Japan braces for 30th named storm this year as Typhoon Champi heads for Okinawa
item.description: The Japan Meteorological Agency says there will be high wind speeds of up to 216 kilometers per hour, as the super typhoon tracks toward Japan.

item.title: Education ministry calls for University of Tokyo to review president selection
item.description: It is the first time the government has requested a review of how a university selected its president.

item.title: One year on, LDP-JIP partnership still has some holes to fill
item.description: With deeper bonds between rank-and-file members of both parties lacking, the coalition is still more of a tie-up between the leaders.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
